topics.display_title: Simon Commission, Nehru Report, Civil Disobedience & Round Table Conferences (1927–1934)

panels.title: Simon exclusion and boycott
ascii_lines: 1927 -> all-British Simon Commission appointed; no Indian member
3 FEB 1928 -> arrival -> hartals + black flags + "Simon Go Back"
POLITICAL RESPONSE -> boycott converts constitutional exclusion into mass protest
EFFECT -> constitutional exclusion becomes a national legitimacy crisis.
source_references: Simon Commission: exclusion becomes a mass issue

panels.title: Lajpat Rai exact chronology
ascii_lines: 30 OCT 1928 -> Lahore lathi-charge during anti-Simon protest
17 NOV 1928 -> Lala Lajpat Rai dies
POLITICAL AFTERLIFE -> the death intensifies anti-colonial anger
DEC 1928 -> Saunders retaliation belongs to the later HSRA chain.
source_references: Lala Lajpat Rai: exact protest chronology and political afterlife

panels.title: Nehru Report constitutional matrix
ascii_lines: STATUS -> Dominion Status, not complete independence
GOVERNMENT -> responsible executive | RIGHTS -> constitutional guarantees
ELECTION -> joint electorates + qualified minority reservations
LIMIT -> constitution-making milestone; communal settlement incomplete.
source_references: Nehru Report: an Indian constitutional design

panels.title: From Calcutta to Lahore
ascii_lines: DEC 1928 -> Calcutta gives a one-year Dominion ultimatum
31 OCT 1929 -> Irwin Declaration | Delhi Manifesto seeks implementation
DEC 1929 -> Lahore adopts Purna Swaraj
26 JAN 1930 -> Independence Pledge.
source_references: Calcutta ultimatum, Irwin Declaration and Delhi Manifesto

panels.title: Dandi march exact-data rail
ascii_lines: 12 MAR 1930 -> Sabarmati -> Gandhi + 78 chosen followers
ROUTE -> about 385/388 km; some historical sources state 240 miles
6 APR 1930 -> Dandi -> salt law broken
RULE -> initial party is not the total crowd throughout the march.
source_references: Dandi March: dates, followers and distance discipline

panels.title: Regional civil-disobedience map
ascii_lines: VEDARANYAM -> Rajagopalachari | PAYYANNUR -> Kelappan
ANDHRA -> sibirams | PESHAWAR -> Khudai Khidmatgars
GARHWALI -> refusal to fire | DHARASANA -> Sarojini Naidu
SHOLAPUR -> temporary breakdown of authority.
source_references: Regional spread: coast, Andhra, forests and local repertoires

panels.title: Participation and variation
ascii_lines: WOMEN -> salt-making + picketing + boycott visibility
MUSLIM PARTICIPATION -> uneven; NWFP is the major exception
REGIONAL FORMS -> salt + revenue + forest + worker action
VERDICT -> wide movement, not uniform social geography.
source_references: Dharasana, Sholapur, women and uneven participation

panels.title: Gandhi-Irwin concession balance
ascii_lines: CONGRESS -> suspends CDM + agrees to Second RTC
GOVERNMENT -> bounded release, restoration, salt and picketing concessions
REFUSED -> inquiry into police excesses
5 MAR 1931 -> tactical truce, not independence.
source_references: First RTC and the Gandhi-Irwin Pact balance

panels.title: Round Table Conference sequence
ascii_lines: FIRST RTC, NOV 1930-JAN 1931 -> Congress absent
SECOND RTC, 1931 -> Gandhi sole Congress representative -> deadlock
THIRD RTC, 1932 -> Congress absent; limited/formal importance
RESULT -> conferencing cannot replace political leverage.
source_references: Karachi, Second RTC and renewed repression

panels.title: Karachi social-content bridge
ascii_lines: KARACHI, MARCH 1931
|-- ratifies Gandhi-Irwin Pact
|-- Fundamental Rights
`-- National Economic Programme
USE -> shows what Swaraj should mean socially and economically.
source_references: Karachi, Second RTC and renewed repression

panels.title: Communal Award to Poona Pact
ascii_lines: COMMUNAL AWARD -> separate electorates for Depressed Classes
20 SEP 1932 -> Gandhi's fast begins
24 SEP 1932 -> Poona Pact
REPLACEMENT -> reserved seats in joint electorates
DEBATE -> integration versus independent political voice; coercive context.
source_references: Communal Award, Gandhi-Ambedkar debate and Poona Pact

panels.title: Disputed number and movement closure
ascii_lines: POONA PROVINCIAL SEATS -> local OCR 147 | widespread convention 148
RULE -> attribute variation; never present the total as uncontested
1932-34 -> CDM resumes under repression
EARLY APRIL 1934 -> movement withdrawn.
source_references: Poona seat-number caution, Third RTC and CDM withdrawal

topics.display_title: Left, Peasant, Workers' & States' Peoples' Movements (1930s)

panels.title: Roots-core-bridges chronology
ascii_lines: ROOTS -> AITUC 1920 | Kanpur 1925 | AISPC 1927 | Bihar Sabha 1929
CORE -> CSP 1934 | AIKS/Faizpur 1936 | Ministries 1937-39 | NPC 1938
BRIDGES -> Warli 1945 | Tebhaga/Telangana/Punnapra-Vayalar 1946
GENEALOGY -> Birsa Ulgulan 1899-1900.
source_references: Scope map: roots, 1930s core and late-colonial bridges

panels.title: AITUC versus AIKS
ascii_lines: AITUC -> 1920 -> industrial labour -> Lala Lajpat Rai first president
AIKS -> 1936 -> peasant coordination -> Sahajanand + N.G. Ranga
COMMON -> organised social constituencies enter nationalist politics
TRAP -> never swap dates, bases or offices.
source_references: AITUC and the labour constituency

panels.title: Two-date communist chronology
ascii_lines: TASHKENT 1920 -> international/emigre communist formation
KANPUR 1925 -> all-India organisation formed inside India
WPP -> open workers-peasants activity
CSP 1934 -> distinct socialist current within Congress.
source_references: Communist chronology: Tashkent, Kanpur and WPP

panels.title: Meerut repression-publicity paradox
ascii_lines: 1929 -> arrests target communist and trade-union networks
1929-33 -> prolonged Meerut Conspiracy Case
DIRECT -> disruption + imprisonment
PARADOX -> socialist and labour arguments gain national publicity
RULE -> avoid unreconciled accused counts.
source_references: Meerut Conspiracy Case: repression and publicity

panels.title: CSP inside-Congress map
ascii_lines: BOMBAY, OCTOBER 1934 -> CSP formed within Congress
LEADERS -> J.P. Narayan | Narendra Dev | Lohia | Minoo Masani
METHOD -> radicalise Congress from inside
TRAP -> CSP and CPI are not identical.
source_references: Congress Socialist Party inside Congress

panels.title: Kisan organisation ladder
ascii_lines: 1929 -> Bihar Provincial Kisan Sabha -> Sahajanand Saraswati
APRIL 1936 -> All-India Kisan Congress at Lucknow
OFFICES -> Sahajanand president | N.G. Ranga general secretary
PROGRAMME -> Kisan Manifesto -> Faizpur agrarian demands.
source_references: Bihar Kisan Sabha to AIKS: leadership and Kisan Manifesto

panels.title: Karachi-Faizpur-planning chain
ascii_lines: KARACHI 1931 -> rights + labour + economic programme
FAIZPUR 1936 -> rent, debt, tenure and agricultural-labour demands
NPC 1938 -> planned economic transformation
VERDICT -> social content widens; Congress remains multi-class.
source_references: Karachi-Faizpur-planning social-content chain

panels.title: Congress ministry gap
ascii_lines: ACHIEVEMENT -> provincial tenancy and labour reforms
GAP -> sub-tenants and agricultural labourers remain weakly protected
LIMITS -> restricted franchise + landlord weight + provincial powers
VERDICT -> partial implementation, neither fulfilment nor simple betrayal.
source_references: Congress Ministries: achievements and structural limits

panels.title: AISPC and Praja Mandal field
ascii_lines: DECEMBER 1927 -> first AISPC convention
ORGANISERS -> Balwantrai Mehta | Maniklal Kothari | G.R. Abhayankar
UNITS -> Praja Mandals in princely states
TARGET -> princely autocracy and denial of rights, not British ministries.
source_references: AISPC origins and the princely-state political field

panels.title: Rajkot policy transition
ascii_lines: HARIPURA 1938 -> Congress reiterates restraint
1938-39 -> Praja Mandal awakening expands
RAJKOT -> old non-intervention boundary is directly tested
SHIFT -> closer identification
LIMIT -> later integration was enabled, not predetermined.
source_references: Praja Mandals, Rajkot and changing Congress policy

panels.title: Bose institutional sequence
ascii_lines: HARIPURA 1938 -> Bose president
TRIPURI 1939 -> re-elected against Gandhian preference
CRISIS -> presidency versus Working Committee authority + strategy
RESIGNATION -> Forward Bloc formed in 1939.
source_references: Haripura, Tripuri and the Forward Bloc

panels.title: Genealogy and late bridges
ascii_lines: 1899-1900 -> Birsa Ulgulan: tribal anti-colonial genealogy
1945 -> Warli | 1946 -> Tebhaga, Telangana, Punnapra-Vayalar
CORE 1930s -> organisation, programme, ministries, princely-state awakening
RULE -> preserve chronology while explaining connection.
source_references: Late-colonial agrarian bridges after the 1930s
